displayName: Glassdoor Salary Data API - Employer Profiles, Salaries, Reviews
description: Resolve a company name to a Glassdoor employer id, then pull the employer profile with ratings and CEO approval, up to three full reviews, and salary percentiles by job title. 4 endpoints, 1 credit each, structured JSON.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
